market_question: Will Thomas Massie be the Republican nominee for KY-04?
reasoning: Thomas Massie is a six-term incumbent with deep roots in the district. KY-04 is safe Republican, and Massie has easily defeated every primary challenge to date. No credible opponent has emerged, and his retirement risk is minimal given his age (53) and no public signals.
evidence_points: Massie has never lost a primary since first winning in 2012; recent challenges drew <35% of the vote.
District is R+16 (Cook PVI), where his libertarian-conservative brand resonates with the GOP base.
No notable challenger has declared, and national figures like Trump have not rallied against him ahead of 2026.
